evidence: DioCrafts/OxiCloud has 2 merged PRs, 0 open, and a recorded 100% merge rate with fast review turnaround.
Current trusted-repo list shows only a small number of active targets, which matches the mission to build repeatable success in a few repos rather than scattering effort.
insights.implication: Continue prioritizing repositories where maintainers have already merged work quickly and where contribution scope stays small and reviewable.

insights.theme: Recent failures were mostly process failures, not code-quality rejections
evidence: OxiCloud #259 failed at pre_submit with gate_failed.
OxiCloud #252 failed because implementation completed without the required output artifact.
immichFrame/ImmichFrame #617 was rejected at task admission due to repo health, before implementation started.
insights.implication: The immediate bottleneck is execution discipline and gating hygiene, not lack of candidate issues or inability to produce patches.

insights.theme: Upstream drift and duplicate work are a recurring source of wasted effort
evidence: The PR ledger shows multiple issues marked superseded or already_fixed_upstream.
This pattern appears across several repos, including kubernetes-mcp-server and OxiCloud.
insights.implication: Issue freshness validation must happen immediately before implementation and again before submission to avoid stale work.

insights.theme: Open PR portfolio should stay narrow
evidence: MiniZinc/libminizinc has an open PR blocked by CI.
pallets/jinja has an open PR awaiting review.
Work queue already includes Open-PS2-Loader#1689 waiting on maintainer, and some repos are explicitly marked saturated.
insights.implication: Do not increase parallel PR count aggressively; focus on follow-through and only add new submissions in high-confidence repos.

pattern_identified.primary_pattern: Recent unsuccessful cycles are dominated by stale-target selection and internal process misses rather than maintainer rejection.
supporting_patterns: Trusted repos with prior merges are producing the best outcomes.
Candidate discovery in broad search is yielding many invalid, already-fixed, or low-health targets.
Controller/output-contract compliance needs stricter checks before marking implementation complete.

strategy_changes.change: Adopt a strict pre-implementation freshness gate
strategy_changes.why: Multiple prior targets were already fixed upstream or superseded.
action: Before starting implementation, confirm the issue is still open, unclaimed by an active PR, and not already fixed on default branch.
Repeat this check immediately before submission if implementation took non-trivial time.

strategy_changes.change: Prioritize trust-repo follow-ups over broad discovery when there are open reviewable paths
strategy_changes.why: Merge-rate evidence is strongest in a small set of repositories, especially OxiCloud.
action: Check trusted repos and current open PRs first each cycle.
Only expand discovery when trust repos lack safe, valid, small-scope work.

strategy_changes.change: Add a hard completion checklist for controller artifacts
strategy_changes.why: One recent implementation failed solely because the required output file was missing.
action: Before declaring any stage complete, verify the required result file exists and contains all contract fields.
Treat missing artifacts as a blocking error before handoff.

strategy_changes.change: Tighten admission criteria for non-trusted repos
strategy_changes.why: Recent exploration hit unhealthy repos and saturated ecosystems.
action: Require passing repo-health checks and low PR saturation before any new implementation starts.
Prefer docs/typo/test fixes in mature projects over ambiguous bug fixes in unfamiliar repos.

strategy_changes.change: Keep PR size and concurrency low
strategy_changes.why: Small, fast-review submissions align with the best observed outcomes and reduce failure recovery cost.
action: Target one or two active open PRs plus at most one fresh implementation at a time.
Bias toward minimal diffs well under the 200-line hard cap.
